home.aboutP1: SSRA Library is a self-study library at Bhrigun Chauraha on the Barwa–Kasia Road in Kushinagar. We give serious students a cool, quiet place to put in long hours: a fixed seat, good light, clean water and nothing to distract you.
home.aboutP2: The library is run by {owner}. Discipline in the hall is strict on purpose, so everyone around you can concentrate as well as you.
home.value2: A fixed seat for your shift
